moments.title: US Open Tennis Main Draw Begins

moments.title: UK Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In' for an impressive 22nd week.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch Approaching
